item.tib: rgyun khyer bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzlas chog dbyings nyid rang gsal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog
item.coloph: zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs bzlas chog dbyings nyid rang gsal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog ces bya ba/ rim gro ba rgyal mo rong gi btsun pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu byi zla 9tshes 8 kyi nyin par/ g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sa bkra shis smin grol ri khrod du/ mkha' spyod pa sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas thun mtshams su brtsams pa'o//
